svg.aria-label: The full mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake agent: you confirm (stop); Session: one literature strategist, or several with a merge, written in config.md (the session reads and judges); Literature strategist, unless you give your own sources (agent, only when needed); Literature strategists, the starts the session briefs, at once (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, the merge the session briefs: review.md and refs.bib (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Structure architect (agent); Outline approval (stop); Argument builder (agent); Draft writer, 2 calls: main.tex (agent); A generator phase aborted (stop); Visualization, with data: the figures placed by patch (agent, only when needed); Citation compliance: each claim against its source's full text, unless you said no (agent); The citation style to confirm (stop); Abstract agent: a patch (agent); Peer reviewer, 2 calls (agent); Draft writer, resumed: the statements the result files do not bear out, as a patch (agent, only when needed); Draft writer, resumed: the whole draft again, as one patch (agent); Citation compliance, resumed: the cited sentences of the patch, unless you said no (agent, only when needed); The draft review does not pass (stop); A claim the run cannot support (stop); A reference that cannot be confirmed, only under strict (stop); Script: each patch applied, the compile, the reference checks (script); Formatter: targets, cover letter, AI disclosure, checklist (agent); Draft writer, resumed: content cut once, when over a declared word or page limit (agent, only when needed); A converted file to replace (stop); /writing review, unless you said no (agent, only when needed); The reply to the closing review (stop); Draft writer, resumed: the findings you pick, as a patch (agent, only when needed); The mode to run, for a plain request that fits two modes (stop).
